summary.en: Israel is conducting sweeping operations, artillery shelling and demolishing homes in southern Lebanon, targeting Hezbollah positions and civilian structures. Hezbollah faces legal pressure as Lebanese authorities have charged five members with recruiting and arming others, while sanctions have been imposed on a Lebanese charity and gold companies for aiding the group. The World Bank reports that reconstruction in Lebanon is progressing slowly. The conflict has caused civilian casualties, including children, as noted in recent violations reports. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israel gjennomfører omfattende operasjoner, artilleriskåling og riving av boliger i Sør-Libanon, rettet mot Hizbollah-posisjoner og sivile bygg. Hizbollah møter juridisk press ettersom libanesiske myndigheter har siktet fem medlemmer for rekruttering og bearming av andre, mens sanksjoner er innført mot en libanesisk veldedighetsorganisasjon og gullbedrifter for å ha bistått gruppen. Verdensbanken rapporterer at gjenoppbyggingen i Libanon går sakte. Konflikten har forårsaket sivile tap, inkludert barn, som nevnt i nylige bruddrapporter. UCDP registrerte 4 335 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)
background.extract: An ongoing conflict between the Lebanese militant group Hezbollah and Israel began on 8 October 2023, when Hezbollah launched rockets and artillery at Israeli positions following Hamas's October 7 attacks on Israel. The conflict escalated into a prolonged exchange of bombardments, leading to extensive displacement in Israel and Lebanon. The conflict is part of the broader Middle Eastern crisis that began with Hamas's attack, with the short Israeli invasion of Lebanon in 2024 marking the largest escalation of the Hezbollah–Israel conflict since the 2006 Lebanon War. In Arabic, the conflict (2023–2024) is referred to as the "Support War" or the "Gaza Support War."
